s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma with metastases
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Physical findings include photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Creatine kinase level increased to 1088 U/L
Aldolase level 23.0 U/L
C-reactive protein level 28.6 mg/L
Antinuclear antibody titer 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms, elevated creatine kinase level, and characteristic skin findings

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
shortlist.why_kept: Temporal association with ipilimumab treatment and presence of myositis symptoms

shortlist.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed dermatomyositis-like symptoms

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has underlying malignancy and developed dermatomyositis-like symptoms

shortlist.label: Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated creatine kinase level and presence of muscle symptoms following immunotherapy

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and erythema of upper eyelids, along with elevated creatine kinase and aldolase levels, are consistent with dermatomyositis. The presence of antinuclear antibody titer 1:640 with speckled pattern also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
rejected.why: While ipilimumab can cause myositis, the patient's symptoms and laboratory findings are more consistent with dermatomyositis than a pure myositis.

rejected.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence that the patient's dermatomyositis is directly associated with the melanoma.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis typically occurs in the context of a known cancer, but the patient's symptoms and laboratory findings do not clearly indicate a paraneoplastic syndrome.

rejected.label: Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis or necrosis, making this diagnosis less likely.
